description: Use this when someone asks how many customer conversations are still open or unresolved, in total or per website. Returns the total plus a per-website count, largest first, listing up to 100 websites (no customer or message data). Not for finding which conversations are open.
name: get_unresolved_conversation_counts

totalUnresolved.description: Unresolved conversations across every website, listed or not

websites.description: Up to 100 websites with the most unresolved conversations, largest first. Customer identifiers, staff ids, message text and organization ids are never returned.

websitesTruncated.description: True when more than 100 websites have unresolved conversations

title: Count open conversations
